supersededCandidates.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one full-body NPC sprite view for a modern illustrated 2D creature-adventure game. Image 1 is the identity/outfit reference; use only the bottom-right Biologist Iris of the Delta, not the R06 trainer. Make an EAST-facing right profile: nose and body point toward the viewer's RIGHT; show the character's ANATOMICAL RIGHT side as the near side. Keep anatomy and clothing consistent with the reference and the approved south/front candidate: long dark braid, olive field shirt over beige undershirt, plum field vest, khaki field trousers, tall olive rubber boots, dark-green notebook held at the chest, and a tan crossbody field satchel attached to Iris's ANATOMICAL LEFT hip. Because this is an east-facing profile and Iris's anatomical RIGHT side is the near side, the left-hip satchel is on the FAR side: it must be mostly occluded by the torso, with at most only a small partial edge visible behind the silhouette; do not move it to the near/right hip. Preserve the notebook in front of the torso and the same braid/outfit/accessory design. No extra accessories. Polished modern 2D game illustration, single centered full-body person with both feet visible and generous transparent padding, readable around 56 world pixels. Genuinely transparent background, no haze outside the figure. No scenery, water, plants, ground shadow, other characters, labels, text, border, logo, or watermark. Apparent age and gender presentation are visual proposals, not canon.

supersededCandidates.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this NPC sprite candidate for the Delta biologist Iris. Change only the large crossbody field satchel's fabric/leather panels from tan/ochre to a muted plum-purple matching her existing plum field vest. Keep the brown strap and metal buckles brown/gold. Preserve the exact South/front pose, face, long braid, olive shirt, beige undershirt, plum vest, khaki trousers, olive boots, green notebook, proportions, framing, edges, and transparent background. The bag must remain attached at Iris's ANATOMICAL LEFT hip, on the viewer's RIGHT in this front view. Do not alter any other colors or add/remove details. Keep genuine transparency; no background, shadow, haze, or checkerboard.

reviewNotes: The original frame and prompts support the botanical field role, dark braid, olive shirt, plum vest, notebook and field bag. No age or gender is established in dialogue or canonical design notes.

All four generated canvases have transparent corner pixels and alpha-bearing edges. Nonzero alpha bounds are much wider than the alpha>=128 body bounds, indicating a low-alpha fringe/halo that should be visually reviewed at runtime scale. No cleanup or cropping was applied.

Cardinal side check against the south/front: the tan satchel is on Iris's anatomical left, shown at viewer-right in south and viewer-left in the back-facing north. WEST has nose facing screen-left and the left-side satchel visibly near; EAST v2 has nose facing screen-right and only the far-side satchel edge visible behind the torso. Both profiles were generated independently; no flips were used.

The opaque-body heights are 1320 px south v2, 1353 px north, 1221 px west and 1357 px east v2. At an overall canvas display height of 56 world px, the visible bodies would be approximately 48, 49, 48 and 49 world px respectively; final display calibration may need a larger canvas display size to achieve a 56 px body silhouette.
These are raw candidates only, not accepted or registered assets. No exact runtime origins/display sizes have been calibrated.
